This is a disappointing revival of the cult musical, though We Will Rock You still manages to draw huge audience numbers who are delighted by the music and endless rock references.

cn.t: Critics remain largely unimpressed by this Queen jukebox musical's return, citing Ben Elton's weak book and nonsensical plot, though they acknowledge the show's crowd-pleasing power and Queen's undeniable songbook continue to draw audiences.
